title: 1996 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement: When Walter drove up to the gasoline pump, he noticed that his gasoline tank was \(\dfrac18\) full. He purchased \(7.5\) gallons of gasoline for \(\$10.\) With this additional gasoline, his gasoline tank was then \(\dfrac58\) full. The number of gallons of gasoline his tank holds when it is full is

solutions.text:
The increase is \(\dfrac58 - \dfrac18 = \dfrac12\) of a tank, which equals \(7.5\) gallons.

So a full tank holds \(2 \cdot 7.5 = 15\) gallons.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Going from \(\dfrac18\) to \(\dfrac58\) full is an increase of \(\dfrac12\) of a tank
If half a tank is \(7.5\) gallons, double it for a full tank
